evidence_precedence: Exact source and compiler; historical packet derivations are hypotheses until consumed.

proof_chain.exact_leaf: For every L>0 and K, the invertible diagonal multiplication a+n^2, a=(L/(4*pi))^2, identifies the fixed even seed M0=M2=M4=0 and fixed odd seed M1=M3=0 with the actual moving physical pole-neutral spaces. The induced Gram metrics must be retained.
proof_chain.known: Native pole-neutral carriers, dimensions and nonunitary D equivalence are proved.
proof_chain.missing: Explicit fixed-seed diagonal equivalences and their metric identification; no isometry may be inferred.
proof_chain.next_test: Prove both diagonal directions on raw centered moments before transporting source matrices.

proof_chain.boundary: Equality to native source is restricted to that physical cell; fixed-Q continuation outside it is auxiliary.

proof_chain.missing: Composition with the still-missing G01 fixed carriers and exact positive Gram metrics. Entrywise ambient holomorphy does not identify moving physical eigenvalues by itself.

proof_chain.exact_leaf: At each fixed K,Q prove the neutral compressed energy/metric expansion -c_Q I+kappa_Q X/L^2+O(L^-3) with positive constants in justified fixed coordinates.
proof_chain.known: Exact neutral pole cancellation is proved. Ambient frozen -log L scalar decomposition is proved.
proof_chain.missing: Complete Archimedean and finite-prime large-aperture remainders and their compression through the exact Gram metrics.
proof_chain.next_test: Derive the fixed-Q diagonal and off-diagonal coefficients analytically and compare low-dimensional exact leading matrices. Never label fixed-Q limits as native growing-cutoff asymptotics.

proof_chain.exact_leaf: For every K, the limiting even and odd seed-compression spectra are simple and strictly disjoint via the Jacobi/cyclic rank-one comparison.
proof_chain.known: Bounded historical rational checks K=3..7; these are not all-K proofs.
proof_chain.missing: All-K Jacobi-tail cyclicity, strict rank-one interlacing and treatment of K=2 empty predecessor.
proof_chain.next_test: Prove cyclicity of the exact limiting coordinate vector. The auxiliary polar unitary cannot change the physical D metric.

proof_chain.exact_leaf: The fixed-cell determinant and mutual spectral-resultant functions are not identically zero in the actual source family.
proof_chain.missing: Needs source-faithful G04/G05 or another actual nonvanishing anchor. Ambient analyticity alone is insufficient.
proof_chain.next_test: Find an exact source-specific nonvanishing value or rigorous limiting coefficient for every relevant cutoff.

proof_chain.exact_leaf: Inside each forced negative interval choose an actual prime-cell subinterval avoiding the exceptional sets for all finitely many relevant K<=M.
proof_chain.missing: Native nonidentity from G06, local discreteness, finite exceptional union and interval selection with exact quantifiers.
proof_chain.next_test: After G06, prove the finite-union selection theorem without a uniform gap/width assertion.

proof_chain.exact_leaf: Compose D03 negativity persistence and D04/D05 first-cutoff witnesses with G07, preserving all first-cutoff predicates and same common K for paired parity sources.
proof_chain.known: Round4 common-cutoff negative-ground alternatives explicitly retain the equal-ground branch; strict branches use their genuine source rays.
proof_chain.missing: Cannot remove shared, singular or resonant branches until G07 is proved.
proof_chain.next_test: Keep the D-direct branch active while G01/G04/G05/G06 are pursued.

countermodels.domain: constant real-analytic two-dimensional families on any real interval
countermodels.predecessor: span e2 has energies 1 and 3, hence PSD and positive definite; shell span e1 has codimension one
preserves: negative successors with PSD codimension-one predecessors
countermodels.falsifies: Analyticity plus rank-one transport and first-birth structure imply a subinterval with disjoint spectra or source-visible ground.
countermodels.mechanism: Shared eigenvector e1 is annihilated by f and paired orthogonally to g. The mutual resultant vanishes identically.
